title: Implement stale-tree and stale-map rejection

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 stale-tree and stale-source-map rejection capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: No PCSM stale-tree/stale-map admission package, versioned staleness receipt, current aggregate source-map CID, or package-specific positive/negative vector module exists in the exact admitted Python source forest. Existing generic stale-tree checks are scoped to control-plane request identity or repair-packet tree/forest handles; they neither consume a canonical PCSM source-map identity nor reject an obsolete source-map entry before Python source-link/rewrite admission. PCSM-051 and PCSM-052 independently record the missing SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, aggregate source-map CID, and linker. This dispatch permits only the receipt, so the smallest authority-preserving delta is a typed unavailable disposition rather than a competing staleness authority or unreviewed source mutation.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The required general agent-supervisor suite passes in provider and sealed environments, but it exercises only structured-decoding grammar admission. The source-map prerequisite and a staleness package bound to the exact current forest remain absent; no completion or promotion is authorized.
